summary: 4D affine (homogeneous) transform: multiplies a column-major 4x4 matrix (a3, 16 floats) by a 3-component input vector (a2, components 0-2 read; implicit homogeneous component 1) and writes the resulting 4-component vector (a1[0..3]) into this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC. output.x = a3[0]*x + a3[4]*y + a3[8]*z + a3[12], and similarly rows 1-3, so column 3 of the matrix (a3[12..15]) acts as the translation/affine part. Unconditional and branchless; returns the output pointer a1.

local_names.a1: output vector, 4 consecutive floats at this+0x0..+0xC
local_names.a2: input vector; only components 0-2 (x, y, z) are read
local_names.a3: 4x4 matrix, column-major, 16 consecutive floats (this->matrix layout); translation column is a3[12..15]

operations.description: Compute v4 = a3[8]*a2[2] + a3[4]*a2[1] + a3[0]*a2[0] + a3[12]: output X = dot(matrix row 0, input) + translation component 0.
Compute v5 = a3[9]*a2[2] + a3[5]*a2[1] + a3[1]*a2[0] + a3[13]: output Y = dot(matrix row 1, input) + translation component 1.
Compute v6 = a3[10]*a2[2] + a3[6]*a2[1] + a3[2]*a2[0] + a3[14]: output Z = dot(matrix row 2, input) + translation component 2.
Compute v7 = a3[11]*a2[2] + a3[7]*a2[1] + a3[3]*a2[0] + a3[15]: output W = dot(matrix row 3, input) + translation component 3 (homogeneous coordinate).
Store output Y into a1[1] = this+0x4.
Store output Z into a1[2] = this+0x8.
Store output W into a1[3] = this+0xC.
Return the output vector pointer a1.
